goalDescription: Die lernende Person kann sozialwissenschaftliche Modelle zur Beschreibung moderner Gesellschaft vergleichen.
reviewerModel: Codex; exact serving model identifier not exposed
aspectRatioDecision: Close native16:9 landscape; no exception needed. Format not mechanically normalized.

actualInspection.fachlichePruefung: Three labelled lenses show different explanatory dimensions over the same neighborhood: income/work, lifestyle and relationships. They introduce different model questions without inventing class proportions, ranking people, equating income and lifestyle or asserting one factor completely explains society.
actualInspection.phone: At 360 px the same neighborhood, all three lens headings and large corresponding symbols are clear; tiny background signs are optional.
actualInspection.desktop: At 680 px the shared setting and different selected dimensions remain easy to compare.
actualInspection.actorPerspective: Actors look through the lenses toward the same neighborhood; their positions are coherent, and no actor reads a reversed compulsory document.
actualInspection.style: Friendly clear comic raster, coherent broad colors and approachable people, without photorealism or sterile technical restyling.

interpretationLimits: The lenses are a comparison metaphor, not full formal definitions of named social-science models.
goalTextStatus: Actual current canonical German title/description inspected and matched to bilingual E1 author candidate; no D/P gate attested by this image review.
